source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape with pale green and ochre washes, ink-outlined cliffs, dotted foliage, misty water, distant mountains, pines, gnarled trees, rocks, and a small scholar boat. Calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motif extraction.

motifs.name: upper_sloping_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the tall slanting cliff face at the upper left, including its pale ochre-green washes, dark ink contour ridges, sparse dotted shrubs, and the diagonal rock planes descending into mist. Exclude any red seals near the left margin.
must_preserve: broad translucent tan and green wash gradients
angular ink contour lines along the cliff edge
small black dotted foliage clusters on the slope

motifs.name: arched_upper_rock_mass
motifs.description: Isolate the large arched mountain form across the upper center-left, with its curved green rock face, darker outer ridges, dense dotted foliage, and clustered shrubs along the crest and lower edges.
must_preserve: dark ink ridge lines following the curve

motifs.name: central_crag_shrub_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the vertical crag rising near the center-right below the main arch, including the pointed rock lip, pale green cliff wash, dark creases, and shrubs gathered at its base and top.
must_preserve: thin ink cracks and vertical texture strokes
soft gray-green vegetation at the base

motifs.name: misty_distant_mountains
motifs.description: Isolate the low distant mountain range on the right side, including the central dark peak, softer neighboring ridges, blue-green far peaks, and the horizontal mist band separating them from the foreground.

motifs.name: mid_right_rocky_shore_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right shoreline cluster with rounded green rocks, small dark pebble marks, low shrubs, and several wiry leafless or lightly blossoming trees leaning over the water.
must_preserve: dark ink outlines and crevice strokes
black dotted moss or foliage accents
thin horizontal water lines around the shore

motifs.name: foreground_twin_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground pine group with two tall pale trunks, branching limbs, needle clusters, and surrounding low gnarled trees at the base, while excluding unrelated distant water and boat areas.
must_preserve: two vertical trunks with mottled bark texture
dark knots and hollow marks in the trunks
small base grasses and root strokes

motifs.name: scholar_boat_with_canopy
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat on the right middle-lower water, including the seated scholar figure, long narrow hull, covered woven canopy, steering line, and surrounding minimal water ripples immediately touching the boat.
must_preserve: parallel rib lines on the canopy

motifs.name: foreground_green_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the long foreground rock bank at the bottom, including connected pale green boulders, ochre shadows, ink contours, mossy dot clusters, and the adjacent water-edge ripple lines. Exclude any inscription or seal at the lower left.
must_preserve: pale green and tan wash texture
dark ink contour and crack lines
horizontal water lines along the base

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
